build.title: Plugin model badges, open-in setting, build-engine default rules + Plugin Update plugin

said.text: plugin@1 records the model that built each plugin (all new + existing), shown as a badge wherever plugin info shows; field + setting for where a UI plugin opens (main area default, floating window, dialog, tab group); build engine applies default-config rules from a registry on every build; new Plugin Update plugin (installed list with model/built date/version, axHub catalog check + one-click update, Rebuild with another model with confirmed removal + install); never two installs of the same plugin, never one plugin built by two models.

steps.text: Report build, rule in _claude, plan the fields
plugin@1 builtWith + builtAt + openIn fields; schema, loader, plugins.mjs --check; every plugin.json
Build-engine default-rules registry (build-defaults@1) applied by plugins.mjs / axf build paths; first rule: UI plugins open in the main area
Open-in setting per UI plugin (main / floating window / dialog / tab group) in its settings, hot render
Model badges: Plugin Manager, plugin switches, Settings → Plugins, app tabs/Patches plugin lists
One-instance rule: console loader, plugin-catalog install, lifecycle install refuse a second copy of an id
Plugin Update plugin: server (installed list, axHub catalog check, update)
Plugin Update: Rebuild with <model> (park a from-scratch rebuild, confirmed swap: uninstall old, install new)
Plugin Update web UI + menu + settings
